name: LotKeys Facebook Posting Buddy
notes: Fresh video discovery checks the live Vehicle Profile Videos folder and the signed-in user's existing More Media Videos without requiring the LotKeys Listing to be edited again.
When Video is selected, Posting Buddy prepares it early and hands it to Facebook first, then fills the remaining selected sections while Facebook handles the video.
The fields timer finishes when Facebook has accepted the video and exposes the next Save / Update / Next step; fixed video handoff delays are removed.
Existing Listing photo replacement still rebuilds the Facebook photo set in LotKeys order without appending duplicates.
